content.content: 1. Necessity: the position rule needs S3-new's creation mechanism for the insertion it fixes — without an opened change to place, choosing a position is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the position rule contradicts S3-new; it re-decides neither the mechanism nor what a dependency is. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The position rule is where the creation mechanism meets the dependency set; the gate keeps the use sound without testing insertion itself.
